segments.he: הָכִי קָאָמַר: כׇּל מָקוֹם שֶׁאֵין מַכְנִיסִין בּוֹ חָמֵץ — אֵין צָרִיךְ בְּדִיקָה, וְאוֹצְרוֹת יַיִן וְאוֹצְרוֹת שֶׁמֶן נָמֵי אֵין צָרִיךְ בְּדִיקָה, וּבַמָּה אָמְרוּ שְׁתֵּי שׁוּרוֹת בַּמַּרְתֵּף — מָקוֹם שֶׁמַּכְנִיסִין בּוֹ חָמֵץ, וּבְמִסְתַּפֵּק.
segments.en: The Gemara answers that «this is» what the tanna «is saying: Any place into which one does not take leaven does not require searching, and wine storages and oil storages also do not require searching. And with regard to what» did the Sages «say» that one must search «two rows in a cellar?» This statement is referring to «a place into which one brings leavened bread, and where one supplies» wine from the storage during the meal.

moves.summary: the mishna means storages are exempt, cellar rows apply to one who replenishes
moves.about: the mishna means that storages generally need no search, and the two cellar rows apply where leaven is brought in and one replenishes
